title: Name That Year
intro: [excited] Hop in the time machine, folks! Tonight's episode is Name That Year, a trip through a century of Disney history. [chuckles] No peeking at your phone calendars... I SEE you!

art.prompt: A whimsical brass time machine with spinning clock dials sitting on a glowing timeline road that passes vintage 1920s, 1950s, 1980s and futuristic city skylines Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

categories.title: Practically Perfect
categories.intro: [laughs] Our first stop on the timeline is Cherry Tree Lane. Every clue is from Mary Poppins!

art.prompt: A London rooftop at dusk with chimney sweep brushes, a flying umbrella, a carpet bag and kites drifting over the cherry trees Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: Mary Poppins' umbrella has a handle shaped like the head of this talking bird
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a parrot! [chuckles] And it has opinions. LOTS of opinions.

clues.clue: Dick Van Dyke plays this cheerful chimney sweep and friend of Mary Poppins
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Bert! Chim chiminey, chim chiminey... [laughs] you know the rest.

clues.clue: Mary Poppins premiered in this year, the same year it's a small world debuted at the New York World's Fair
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 1964! [excited] What a year for Walt and the Sherman Brothers.

clues.clue: The Banks family lives at this house number on Cherry Tree Lane
clues.reveal: The correct answer is number 17, Cherry Tree Lane! [whispers] Watch out for the Admiral's cannon.

clues.clue: Mary Poppins Returns arrived in theaters in 2018, this many years after the original film
clues.reveal: [dramatic pause] The correct answer is 54 years! Practically perfect timing, if you ask me.

categories.title: Premiere Night
categories.intro: [excited] Roll out the red carpet! Name the year each of these classics premiered.

art.prompt: A glamorous vintage movie palace marquee at night with spotlights sweeping the sky, a red carpet and velvet ropes, bulbs glowing, no text on the marquee Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: Name the year this film premiered: Frozen
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 2013! [laughs] And we still can't let it go.

clues.clue: Name the year this film premiered: The Lion King
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 1994! [excited] The circle of life started spinning thirty-plus years ago.

clues.clue: Name the year this film premiered: Beauty and the Beast (the animated original)
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 1991! A tale as old as time... well, as old as 1991.

clues.clue: Name the year this film premiered: Peter Pan
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 1953! [chuckles] Peter never grew up, but the film sure did.

clues.clue: Name the year this film premiered: Bambi
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is 1942! Released in the middle of World War Two.

categories.title: Snapshot in Time
categories.intro: [mischievously] Look closely at the cars, clothes and buildings. These are park opening days... name the year!

art.prompt: A stack of old photographs and Polaroids from different decades fanned out on a wooden table, faded colors and film grain Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: Snapshot in time! This park opening day scene is from which year? (Hint: Disneyland in California)
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 1955! [excited] July 17th, the day Walt's dream opened its gates.

media.prompt: A sunny 1950s opening day at a new California theme park: families in 1950s dresses, hats and suits, tail-finned cars in a dirt parking lot, a Victorian main street with a horse-drawn streetcar and a small pastel castle, warm Kodachrome photo look Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: Snapshot in time! This park opening day scene is from which year? (Hint: Disney-MGM Studios in Florida)
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 1989! Today we call it Disney's Hollywood Studios.

media.prompt: A late-1980s opening day at a Florida movie-studio theme park: guests in neon windbreakers, big permed hair and fanny packs, an art deco Hollywood boulevard and a giant water tower, glossy 1980s snapshot look Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: Snapshot in time! This park opening day scene is from which year? (Hint: Euro Disney in France)
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 1992! [laughs] Ooh la la! It's Disneyland Paris now.

media.prompt: An early-1990s opening day at a new theme park outside Paris: crowds in oversized denim jackets, a pink fairy-tale castle with pointed blue turrets, French flags, misty April morning, 1990s disposable camera look Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: Snapshot in time! This park opening day scene is from which year? (Hint: Hong Kong Disneyland)
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 2005! [chuckles] Same year Disneyland turned 50. Happy birthday, everybody!

media.prompt: A mid-2000s opening day at a theme park on Lantau Island in Hong Kong: guests with flip phones and early digital cameras, a white and blue castle with green mountains behind, tropical sunshine Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: Snapshot in time! This park opening day scene is from which year? (Hint: Shanghai Disneyland)
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 2016! [excited] Home of the biggest Disney castle in the world.

media.prompt: A 2010s opening day at a huge new theme park in Shanghai: guests holding smartphones and selfie sticks, an enormous modern fairy-tale castle with many spires, a giant garden and a glittering skyline at dusk Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

categories.title: Anniversary Arithmetic
categories.intro: [sighs] Uh oh... math! [laughs] Don't worry, these are anniversary years, not homework.

art.prompt: A giant birthday cake shaped like a castle with rows of candles, confetti and an old-fashioned chalkboard full of doodled numbers Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: Mickey Mouse debuted in Steamboat Willie in 1928, so he turns 100 in this year
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 2028! [excited] One hundred candles on one giant cake!

clues.clue: Walt Disney World opened in October 1971 and kicked off its 50th anniversary celebration in this year
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 2021! The World's Most Magical Celebration ran for eighteen months.

clues.clue: Tokyo Disneyland opened in 1983, so it celebrated its 40th anniversary in this year
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 2023! [chuckles] Forty years young.

clues.clue: Disney+ launched in the United States in this year
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 2019! November 12th, to be exact. [laughs] Goodbye, free time.

clues.clue: Disney bought Pixar in 2006 and completed its purchase of Marvel in this year
clues.reveal: [dramatic pause] The correct answer is 2009! Lucasfilm followed in 2012.

categories.title: Back in Time
categories.intro: [whispers] Hold on tight... we're traveling through time! Name these time-twisting Disney details.

art.prompt: A swirling time vortex of clocks and gears pulling a little flying saucer-shaped time machine through glowing blue light Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: In Meet the Robinsons, Wilbur takes Lewis to the future in this
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a time machine! [laughs] Keep moving forward!

clues.clue: In The Sword in the Stone, this wizard has already visited the future and talks about things like airplanes
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Merlin! [chuckles] He even wears a Bermuda vacation outfit. Very trendy.

clues.clue: In Avengers: Endgame, the heroes travel back in time to collect these six powerful gems
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Infinity Stones! [excited] Whatever it takes!

clues.clue: In Meet the Robinsons, young orphan Lewis grows up to become this famous inventor
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Cornelius Robinson! [gasps] Lewis was his own future all along.

clues.clue: The Bowler Hat Guy in Meet the Robinsons is actually Lewis's grown-up, sleepy roommate with this nickname
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Goob! [sighs] Catch the ball, Goob... CATCH THE BALL!
